summary: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, reporting that Nasdaq approved its transfer from the Nasdaq Global Market to the Nasdaq Capital Market, effective the same day. The move follows an August 21 deficiency notice for failing Listing Rule 5450(a)(2), which requires 400 total holders. The company applied August 26; approval came September 14. The transfer renders the total-holder deficiency moot. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. Watch whether the lower-tier listing impairs the SPAC's ability to complete an initial business combination before its deadline, and any further deficiency notices.
